VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify acceptance criteria satisfaction. While the agent claims all 31 tests pass locally, there is no independent evidence (CI logs, test output, code diff, or artifacts) to corroborate this claim. The absence of CI logs is particularly problematic for a billing system where rounding correctness is critical. A self-report without supporting documentation does not meet the evidentiary standard required to confirm acceptance criteria have been met.
